purpose: A dumped scope is a place in the source. Two classes of row are not: the sentinel 0:0..0:0, written when a node is recorded as having no position, and a negative range, written when a closed (line, column) interval is asked to express an empty one. Both are symptoms of one representation defect — the dump has no spelling for "no position" or "empty" that does not borrow a coordinate. This ledger used to name M3's extents as the cure and cite docs/reviews/2026-08-05-m3-endstate-poc.md as its authority; that design was reverted on 2026-08-07 (docs/reviews/2026-08-07-requirement-audit.md) and the cure is a dump spelling, not a substrate. Until it exists the counts may only shrink, with one recorded exception: regression.txt's sentinel budget went 18 -> 19 on 2026-08-10, because the autolink position defect it now pins only appears on a paragraph whose buffer holds more than its first line, and a second line is a SoftBreak. The row is the same known class the ledger already tracks, not a new one. When every count reaches zero this ledger and scripts/audit-scope-sanity.mjs are deleted, not kept at zero.
